reviews.title: Excellent Product and Outstanding Customer Support – Golense X2 Smart Lock
reviews.body: I am really happy with my experience with the Golense X2 Smart Lock. The product offers good features, convenience, and a modern smart-home experience. What impressed me most was the proactive support from the Golense team, especially during installation and configuration. Their team was very responsive, patient, and willing to guide me through the process whenever I faced any difficulties. Another great thing is their commitment to customer satisfaction. reviews.author: Chikka Joonna
reviews.title: Installation easy and they guide everything proper
reviews.body: Had a wonderful experience with Golens Locks! The lock quality is excellent, and the product is impressive. Their customer support is outstanding. The team patiently explained everything, including how to use and operate the lock. Very professional, helpful, and supportive staff. reviews.author: rajesh bhatia
reviews.title: Overall Good
reviews.body: Overall good. This is I think the only option that is available for the doors where soace is less than 60mm between saftey and main door. All other doorlocks require 65mm or more space. Till now it is working good. Sometimes, it misses the fingerprint recognition, but not much. Isntallation process and the oerson who installed provided good service. Overall satisfactory till now. Just one thing, that till now i couldnt get any update on getting passgae mode ON in this lock.
